matches.rationale: Finding 1 directly identifies that the contribution claim favoring G3 (key-layer gating) as superior contradicts the paper's own Table 1 data and its Abstract/Sec 3.2.1 statement that SDPA (G1) or value (G2) gating is most effective — the same G1-vs-G3 contradiction described in the ground truth.

No finding addresses Eq. 5's gating formulation (additive vs multiplicative) or the sigma/SiLU inconsistency; findings 3-8 concern entirely different equations (footnote 2, Figure 3/7 statistics, parameter counts, Eq. 1/3 head dimensions).
